title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.5.0
subtitle: A Beta update without username prompts or installation presence.

highlights.title: Simpler Preferences
highlights.description: The Superhive Username preference and first-run username prompt from 2.4.10 have been removed.

highlights.title: No Installation Heartbeat
highlights.description: Cloth NeXt no longer reads or writes installation identity files or sends periodic installation-presence requests.

highlights.title: Existing Workflow Preserved
highlights.description: Continue using the existing Bake, Live View, negative Shrink, and toolbar improvements. The external solver remains separate.
